title: Accessibility, Multiview Authoring, Performance & Recovery

bounded_contract.required_equivalence: Every consequential authoring operation exposed in one supported modality/view must have an equivalent governed operation and accessible nonvisual summary without changing semantic identity.
bounded_contract.multiview_identity: All views project shared stable semantic reference IDs; no view owns a separate canonical spatial ledger.
bounded_contract.performance_contract: Large-map and deep-topology work is bounded by deterministic window/batch limits and stable ordering; wall-clock timing is not semantic truth and is not an acceptance oracle.
bounded_contract.conflict_contract: Expected owner version mismatches return explicit conflict outcomes and replacement owner-operation proposals; they never silently overwrite owner state.
bounded_contract.recovery_contract: Undo/recovery produces versioned, idempotent inverse/recovery proposals or reversible projection operations; no canonical rollback occurs in SSA.
bounded_contract.authorization_contract: Authorization precedes projection; hidden or GM-only semantics and protected cardinality are filtered before any view or modality projection.
bounded_contract.serialization_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs serialize deterministically independent of modality, view and input ordering.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable SSA-09 persistence is required; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

preserved_boundaries: Completed spatial foundations remain canonical inputs and are not mutated by SSA-09 projections.
Scene, MAI, ISE, World/Reality, Event, Permission/entitlement, provider/media-rights and other owner domains remain canonical.
No pointer, gesture, visual layout or pixel position becomes semantic truth by itself.
Accessibility equivalence cannot weaken permission filtering, provenance, owner validation or hidden-cardinality protection.
Performance optimizations cannot change semantic truth, ordering, authorization or deterministic serialization.
Undo/recovery and conflict handling cannot silently rewrite canonical owner state, owner history or bypass version checks.
No durable SSA-09 persistence or migration 0022 is introduced.
SSA-10, tester distribution, paid provider activation, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
acceptance_contract: Test-first RED must prove the bounded SSA-09 contract/panel do not exist before production implementation.
Equivalent keyboard, touch, pen and nonvisual intents must yield the same normalized governed operation identity.
Multiple views over the same semantic references must not create duplicate canonical truth or hidden-cardinality leaks.
Large/deep input must use deterministic bounded windows/batches with stable serialization rather than timing-dependent behavior.
Version conflicts and duplicate idempotency keys must be explicit; undo/recovery must remain proposal-only.
Consequential operations require accessible nonvisual summaries.
Final validation uses exactly one SSA-09 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero predecessor fanout.
